say:2:1030111702:1.source_cn: 如此美景，当然是要好好欣赏了。

say:3:1030111703:1.text: I wish I could keep watching it until everything was reduced to ashes... It has been years since my last experience with such grand flames.
say:3:1030111703:1.source_cn: 真想一直看下去，直到一切都化为灰烬……上次看到如此盛大...
say:3:1030111703:1.male: I wish I could keep watching it until everything was reduced to ashes... It has been years since my last experience with such grand flames.
say:3:1030111703:1.female: I wish I could keep watching it until everything was reduced to ashes... It has been years since my last experience with such grand flames.

say:4:1030111704:1.text: That time, I saw a beautiful red-haired lady in town. She snapped her fingers, and flames ignited in her wine glass.
say:4:1030111704:1.source_cn: 那时候，我在镇子上见到一位美丽的红发女士，她打了个响指...
say:4:1030111704:1.male: That time, I saw a beautiful red-haired lady in town. She snapped her fingers, and flames ignited in her wine glass.
say:4:1030111704:1.female: That time, I saw a beautiful red-haired lady in town. She snapped her fingers, and flames ignited in her wine glass.

say:5:1030111705:1.text: Compared to the sparks created at her fingertips, this fire is great in strength but lacks the breathtaking beauty I saw.
say:5:1030111705:1.source_cn: 和她指尖迸出的火花相比，这里的火只是声势浩大，却少了动...
say:5:1030111705:1.male: Compared to the sparks created at her fingertips, this fire is great in strength but lacks the breathtaking beauty I saw.
say:5:1030111705:1.female: Compared to the sparks created at her fingertips, this fire is great in strength but lacks the breathtaking beauty I saw.

say:6:1030111706:1.text: Sadly, I have other things to take care of. We'll have to continue another time.
say:6:1030111706:1.source_cn: 唉……可惜我还有别的事要做，就先聊到这里吧。
say:6:1030111706:1.male: Sadly, I have other things to take care of. We'll have to continue another time.
